title: GraphQL Federation
description: Implement Apollo Federation with multiple services, federated queries, entity resolution via @key, and service status.

steps.title: Service A _service SDL
steps.description: Create Service A (users) that exposes a _service query returning its SDL string for the federation gateway.
hints: The SDL should include the User type with @key directive
Use Apollo Federation libraries or build a custom implementation

steps.title: Service B _service SDL
steps.description: Create Service B (reviews) that exposes its own _service query with Review type and references to User via @key.
hints: Service B's SDL includes Review type with extends User
Use the extend keyword to reference User from Service A

steps.title: Federated query across services
steps.description: Create a gateway that queries both services and combines results. Query users with their reviews across services.
hints: The gateway makes requests to both Service A (port 3001) and Service B (port 3002)
Combine the results from both services
Return a federated response with data from both

steps.title: Entity resolution via @key
steps.description: Implement entity resolution: the gateway can request a User entity by ID and get data from both services.
hints: Service A resolves User entities with _entities query
The gateway sends a representations array with __typename and id
Service A returns the user data, Service B enriches with reviews

steps.title: Federation status
steps.description: Create GET /federation/status that returns the list of registered services and their health status.
hints: Track which services are registered in the federation
Check each service's health by calling its _service endpoint
Return the list with service name, URL, and status
